description: Read public pages as Markdown with title, language and word count. GET accepts one URL; POST or MCP accepts one URL or an array of up to five in url. An array returns pages in input order. The flat price covers the entire call. A batch fails without settlement if any page cannot be read. No JavaScript rendering, account or API key. $0.0025 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

links.description: Also return the outbound links as a list. Defaults to false.

url.description: A public HTTP/HTTPS URL. POST and MCP also accept an array of up to five URLs.

name: web_read
title: Read a web page as markdown
